name: Dcondo Reef Kathu
shortDescription: Completed Sansiri condominium in Kathu with 706 studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments across four eight-storey buildings.
description:
Listed as Dcondo Reef Phuket, a large completed project by Sansiri in Kathu: four buildings of eight storeys with 706 apartments on a site of about 12,800 sqm, finished in September 2024.
Advertised resale units are studios of about 28 sqm, one-bedroom apartments of 24-34 sqm and two-bedroom apartments of around 50-52 sqm. The project has a communal pool, gym, co-working space, garden, reception and EV charging, with parking for about 40% of units.
Tesco Lotus Kathu is about 2 km away and Phuket International Airport about 32 km. Unit counts differ by source (Hipflat shows 161), so the portal figure of 706 is used.
